conflictDescription: The following questions have conflicts between local and remote versions. Please select a resolution strategy.
confirmConflictResolveDescription: "{{strategy}}" will be applied, overwriting the other version's data. This cannot be undone. We recommend creating a local backup first.
confirmConflictBatchResolveDescription: {{strategy}} will be applied to {{count}} conflicts, replacing the other versions. This cannot be undone.
experimentalBadgeTooltip: Experimental feature. We recommend backing up your data first.

autoSync.label: Auto Sync
autoSync.description: Off by default. When enabled, a bidirectional sync (keep-latest strategy) runs at the selected interval; failures back off exponentially. When the cloud is not configured, a password is missing, or the sync lease is held by another device, the run is silently skipped without error popups.

outcome.skippedUnconfigured: Skipped: cloud not configured or password missing
outcome.skippedBusy: Skipped: another sync is in progress
outcome.skippedLeaseHeld: Skipped: sync lease held by another device

newer_hint: Keeping the newer version is recommended
migration_required: A schema mismatch was detected. Run the database migration before syncing.
conflict_description: Conflicts were detected between local and cloud data. Select a resolution strategy.
record_conflicts_count_only: {{count}} record-level conflicts were found, but details are unavailable. Select a merge strategy to resolve them.
sync_ready: Data is synced; there are no conflicts to resolve.

record_conflict_panel.title: Record Conflicts ({{count}})
record_conflict_panel.undoable_hint: You can act with confidence: before bulk resolution or a database-wide policy override, the affected records are automatically snapshotted on this device (never uploaded). If something goes wrong, roll back with one click in the Automatic Snapshots section below.

conflict_type.schema_mismatch_desc: Local and cloud database schema versions differ, migration needed
conflict_type.data_conflict_desc: Both local and cloud have data modifications with conflicts
conflict_type.checksum_mismatch_desc: Data versions match but contents differ, possible data corruption
conflict_type.local_only_desc: This database only exists locally, not in cloud
conflict_type.cloud_only_desc: This database only exists in cloud, not locally

strategy_info.keep_local_desc: Overwrite cloud with local data, local changes will be pushed
strategy_info.use_cloud_desc: Overwrite local with cloud data, cloud changes will be synced
strategy_info.keep_latest_desc: Automatically select the newer version based on update time
strategy_info.manual_desc: Review and resolve each conflicting record individually

errors.legacyPlaintextRejected: The cloud directory still contains unencrypted data uploaded before encryption was enabled. To keep end-to-end encryption from being bypassed, this sync stopped without reading that data. To fix it: temporarily clear the encryption password in the cloud sync settings, run one download sync to merge the cloud data into this device, then empty that cloud directory (or switch to a new one), set the password again, and run a full upload.
errors.encryptionPasswordMissing: The cloud data is end-to-end encrypted, but no encryption password is set on this device. Enter the password that was used when encryption was first enabled in the cloud sync settings, then try again.
errors.wrongEncryptionPassword: The cloud data could not be decrypted: the encryption password is incorrect (or the cloud data is corrupted). Update the password in the cloud sync settings to match your other devices and try again; every device connected to the same cloud directory must use the same encryption password.

notifications.conflictBatchResolvePartial: Some conflicts could not be resolved: {{resolved}} succeeded, {{failed}} failed
